metadata.title: Uncovering Student Strategies for Solving Scientific Inquiry Tasks: Insights from Student Process Data in PISA

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as it analyzes process-log data rather than cognitive achievement scores.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it does not apply PISA complex survey weights in its analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzes individual student-level data without employing multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and only discusses internal validation methods.
